title: PROOF TILES
rule: every tile is a crop of the part that proves its caption, and its caption is a result
description: A lead tile and a grid of 16:10 tiles. Each tile is a crop of a public screen, a recreation, or one plain figure, cut on whole UI parts to the part that proves the line under it. A vermilion ring marks that part, and the words it proves carry a vermilion band. The lead tile is a shipped product: the Bayyinah TV pricing page, 'Members subscribe on the web, iPhone or Android.', with the two strongest other results beside it: one billing report, 16 database requests before and 2 after, and the Viva Fresh Albanian checkout.
signature: Archivo (the identity sentence at 28 px, weight 500, the name in it at weight 750; results at 18 px, the lead result at 24 px) and Martian Mono for years, numbers and labels, both as font-display optional faces with a preload and a 300 ms cap. Palette: paper #ECECE8, ink #111111, muted #53534D (6.3:1), one accent, vermilion #FF5A36, used only for proof: the billing figure, the rings, the proof bands. Desktop 1440: 'Gentrit Rashiti builds web and mobile apps. / Each result below is shown on the screen that proves it.', then '5+ years. Part of two platform rewrites. Based in Kosovo, working remotely.', Download CV and Email at the right. First screen: the lead tile, 888 x 555 (a 1000 x 625 source crop drawn at 0.89), with its result, one scope line ('The second version is a new app: 34 pages, in English and Arabic.') and its project line; beside it the 16 -> 2 figure and the Viva Fresh checkout, 432 x 270 each. Then rows of three: care organization switch (recreation), Incentiv passkey, Design System v2 button row (recreation); Read to Feed reading progress, Dukagjini search, bayyinah.org store badges; then the index of 30. Each tile is one link, named by its result, project and 'Case'; it sits under the caption and covers the tile with a pseudo-element, so the picture holds no control and the live recreations are inert. The 'Recreation · invented data' label sits under the plate, never on it. Motion, one state change: when a tile becomes current (mouse hover, keyboard focus, or after a scroll on touch, the tile at the middle of the screen), the page ground takes the screen's measured hue (oklch 0.935 0.035 h, background-color 200 ms, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), a second vermilion ring closes onto the proof (scale 1.12 -> 1 and opacity, 200 ms), and the proof band fills. Nothing in the picture dims. Keyboard: Tab, then arrows (left and right in reading order, up and down to the nearest tile in the next row), Home and End; a keyboard move changes at once. Reduced motion: no fade, no transition. Phone: one column, max 432 px, 16 px gutters; the lead uses a 440 x 275 crop of the price.
holdback: Lowest: meaningful motion, original and hooks, 7 each. The only motion is feedback when a tile becomes current (ground tint, closing halo, band fill); it explains which proof belongs to which words but nothing changes state. A lead tile beside a grid is still a familiar portfolio layout; the proof rule (ring plus band) is the new part, and there is no single moment to remember. Other limits: the Bayyinah TV ring proves 'subscribe' on the web only, not iPhone or Android; the design-system ring proves 'building blocks', not 36 or 20 releases; the Read to Feed crop shows the light-blue edge of the store frame at both sides (the only 16:10 cut that holds two whole book cards); the phone crop of the lead ends inside the first feature row under its check mark (no text is cut); the lead's project line sits about 40 px under its scope line so that it aligns with the Viva Fresh line; on a cold load where a face misses the 300 ms cap, the page keeps the system fallback for that visit (seen once in a headless run under load: Martian Mono fell back).

chroma.method: scratchpad/chroma6r.mjs decode and threshold (review/loop8/proof-tiles/chroma-pt.mjs) on review/loop8b/proof-tiles/final/d-top.png (1440 x 900), captured last. outsidePlates counts the billing figure as a plate; outsideScreenPlates counts it as page.

hues.method: OKLCH hue histogram, chroma-weighted, 1 degree bins smoothed over 13 degrees, over each crop in source pixels (review/loop8/proof-tiles/hue.mjs); live tiles use their world accent

fixed: Name set inside the identity sentence at 28 px, weight 750 for the name; the 64 px name headline is gone (critic polish 1, devil 'giant name').
Own identity line: 'Each result below is shown on the screen that proves it.' plus '5+ years. Part of two platform rewrites.' in every view.

First screen holds three tiles: a shipped product lead (Bayyinah TV pricing, 888 x 555) with 16 -> 2 and Viva Fresh beside it (critic polish 2, devil single change). Followed the shared brief and the devil (lead with a shipped product screen) over the critic's '16 -> 2 lead', because the devil showed the backend figure as off-role for a frontend hire.

Each tile is one link under the caption, named by aria-labelledby (result, project, 'Case'); the picture is outside the link and the recreations are inert: 0 controls inside links, was 40 (critic polish 3, devil 35 nested buttons).
Grey dimmer removed; hover keeps the ground tint and adds a closing vermilion halo, so no tile looks disabled (devil, d-hover-bayyinah-end).
Proof words carry a highlighter band, not a link underline (devil 'underlines look like links').

Crops end on whole UI parts: Dukagjini ends under the search card (no half chips), Read to Feed ends under two whole book cards, Incentiv keeps 31 px right of WalletConnect, bayyinah.org ring moved to the store badges.
Recreation label moved under the plate; it covers no chart axis (critic polish 5, devil).

Copy: billing caption 'A billing report that timed out now finishes.' (the fact is said once, the figure shows the number); Dukagjini 'Search, sales and checkout, live in both app stores.'; bayyinah.org 'Live at bayyinah.org, with links to both app stores.'; Read to Feed role 'Mobile' and caption 'About 14 updates shipped. Books reopen where children stopped.'; index rows for the fuel-station app and the design dashboard rewritten; care role 'Frontend'.
Fonts: preload of the four faces, font-display optional copies, a 300 ms cap (was 1.5 s). CLS 0 with fonts held 2.5 s at 375 and 1440; text visible about 55 ms after mount.
Touch: the ground changes only after the first scroll (was pink on load), from a scroll listener with requestAnimationFrame (was IntersectionObserver, about 0.6 s late).
Arrow keys move by geometry, so up and down work with the lead tile at every width.
